We are recruiting to fill the position below:

Job Position: Operations Officer
     

            
    



Job Location: Abuja (FCT)
Employment Type: Full-time
Industry: Warehousing & Distribution
Work Schedule: Monday – Friday 

Job Summary


	We are seeking a proactive and organized Operations Officer to support the day-to-day operations of our warehousing and distribution business.
	The ideal candidate will ensure operational efficiency, coordinate cross-functional activities, monitor workflow, and help maintain high service standards across the organization.


Key Responsibilities


	Coordinate daily operational activities to ensure smooth business processes.
	Monitor warehouse and distribution operations to ensure timely order fulfillment.

	Monitor inventory movement and resolve operational issues promptly.
	Assist in planning and implementing process improvements to increase efficiency.
	Maintain accurate operational records and documentation.
	Support vendor and customer coordination where necessary.
	Identify operational risks and recommend corrective actions.
	Ensure efficient use of company resources to minimize operational costs.
	Perform other operational and administrative duties as assigned.


Requirements


	Bachelor's Degree in Business Administration, Logistics, Supply Chain Management, Operations Management, or a related field.
	Minimum of 3 years of experience in operations, logistics, warehousing, or distribution.
	Strong understanding of warehouse and distribution processes.
	Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite, particularly Excel.
	Experience using ERP or warehouse management systems is an added advantage.
	Excellent analytical, organizational, and problem-solving skills.
	Strong communication and interpersonal skills.
	Ability to multitask and work effectively in a fast-paced environment.


Key Competencies:


	Operations Management
	Logistics & Distribution Coordination
	Process Improvement
	Data Analysis & Reporting
	Inventory Coordination
	Problem-Solving
	Time Management
	Team Collaboration
	Attention to Detail
	Decision-Making.

	Competitive salary
	Career growth and development opportunities
	Collaborative work environment
	Continuous learning and professional development.

Data Analyst Job at Audacious Circle Careers




        
    

        
        Audacious Circle Careers was founded with a singular conviction: that Africa's organisations deserve a talent partner as ambitious as their vision. We exist at the intersection of consulting rigour and human empathy — combining data-driven methodology with a genuine commitment to the people and businesses we serve.

From our headquarters in Lagos, we've grown into a trusted partner to 500+ organisations and 5,000+ professionals across the continent. Our approach rejects the transactional nature of traditional recruitment in favour of strategic, long-term partnerships that create enduring value. 

We are  recruiting to fill the position below:

 Job Position: Data Analyst
     

            
    



Job Location: Abuja (FCT) 
Employment Type: Full-time
Industry: Warehousing & Distribution
Work Schedule: Monday – Friday

Job Summary


	We are looking for a detail-oriented and analytical Data Analyst to collect, analyze, and interpret business data to support strategic decision-making.
	The ideal candidate will provide actionable insights that improve operational efficiency, inventory management, sales performance, and overall business growth.


Key Responsibilities


	Collect, clean, analyze, and interpret data from multiple business sources.
	Develop dashboards and reports to monitor key business and operational metrics.
	Analyze inventory, sales, warehouse, and distribution data to identify trends and opportunities.
	Generate periodic performance reports for management.
	Identify process inefficiencies and recommend data-driven improvements.
	Collaborate with operations, finance, sales, and warehouse teams to support business decisions.
	Monitor KPIs and provide insights on business performance.
	Ensure data accuracy, integrity, and confidentiality.
	Automate recurring reports where possible.
	Present findings and recommendations to management in a clear and concise manner.
	Support forecasting and business planning through data analysis.


Requirements


	Bachelor's Degree in Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Science, Economics, Data Science, or a related field.
	Minimum of 3 years of experience as a Data Analyst, preferably in a warehousing, logistics, FMCG, manufacturing, or distribution company.
	Proficiency in Microsoft Excel (advanced), SQL, and Power BI or Tableau.
	Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
	Experience working with ERP systems is an added advantage.
	Knowledge of statistical analysis and data visualization techniques.
	Excellent communication and presentation skills.
	High attention to detail and accuracy.


Key Competencies:


	Data Analysis & Interpretation
	SQL
	Microsoft Excel (Advanced)
	Power BI/Tableau
	Data Visualization
	Reporting & Dashboard Development
	Business Intelligence
	Statistical Analysis
	Critical Thinking
	Problem-Solving
	Attention to Detail


What We Offer


	Competitive salary
	Career growth and development opportunities
	Collaborative work environment
	Continuous learning and professional development


Method of Application 
Interested and qualified candidates should send their CV to: [email protected] using "Data Analyst" as the subject of the email.
